translation_snapshot.source:
Numbing Poison - Reduces global speed by %d%% for 5 turns.
		Insidious Poison - Applies a standard poison that deals %0.2f nature damage over 5 turns.
		Crippling Poison - Places %d talents on cooldown for %d turns.
		Leeching Poison - Heals you for %d.
		Volatile Poison - Deals a further %0.2f nature damage to foes in a radius %d ball.
translation_snapshot.target:
麻木毒素——全局速度降低 %d%%， 持续 5 回合。
		阴险毒素——使目标中毒，在 5 回合内受到 %0.2f 点自然伤害。
		致残毒素——令 %d 个技能进入 %d 回合冷却。
		吸血毒素——为你恢复 %d 点生命。
		易爆毒素——额外造成 %0.2f 点自然伤害，波及半径 %d 内的敌人。

translation_snapshot.source: Enhances your Deadly Poison with a numbing agent, causing the poison to reduce all damage the target deals by %d%%.
translation_snapshot.target: 为你的致命毒素加入麻木成分，使该毒素令目标造成的所有伤害降低 %d%%。

translation_snapshot.source:
Learn how to enhance your Deadly Poison, adding additional effects. Each level, you will learn a new kind of poison enhancement:
	Level 1: Numbing Poison
	Level 2: Insidious Poison
	Level 3: Crippling Poison
	Level 4: Leeching Poison
	Level 5: Volatile Poison
	New poison enhancements can also be learned from special teachers in the world.
	Also increases the effectiveness of your poisons by %d%%. (The effect varies for each poison.)
	Adjusting your weapon coating takes no time and does not break stealth.
	You may only have two poison enhancements active at once; applying a third will randomly cause one of the existing ones to be cancelled.
translation_snapshot.target:
学会强化致命毒素，为其附加额外效果。每投入一级，你都会学会一种新的毒素强化：
	等级 1：麻木毒素
	等级 2：阴险毒素
	等级 3：致残毒素
	等级 4：吸血毒素
	等级 5：易爆毒素
	还能向世界中的特殊导师学习新的毒素强化。
	毒素效果提高 %d%% （具体效果因毒素而异）。
	调整武器涂层不消耗时间，也不会打破潜行。
	同时最多激活两种毒素强化；激活第三种时，会随机取消一种已激活的强化。

translation_snapshot.source:
Enhance your Deadly Poison with a stoning agent.  Whenever you apply Deadly Poison, you afflict your target with an additional earth-based poison that inflicts %d nature damage per turn (stacking up to %d damage per turn) for %d turns.
		After either %d turns or the poison has run its course (<100%% chance, see effect description), the target will be turned to stone for %d turns.
		The damage scales with your Cunning.
translation_snapshot.target:
以石化成分强化你的致命毒素。每当你施加致命毒素时，目标还会受到一种土系毒素，每回合造成 %d 点自然伤害（可叠加至每回合 %d 点伤害），持续 %d 回合。
		%d 回合后或者毒素效果结束后（几率小于100%%，请参见效果介绍），目标将被石化 %d 回合。
		受灵巧影响，伤害按比例加成。
